newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan police issue new arrest order for Zardari.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan police issue new arrest order for Zardari.

text.p: Pakistani authorities issued a new order for the arrest of Asif Ali Zardari, husband of ousted prime minister Benazir Bhutto, ahead of his scheduled release from jail on court orders, police said on Thursday.

Police said Zardari's new arrest order was issued in connection with the murder of Mir Murtaza Bhutto, brother of Benazir, who was killed in a police shootout on September 20 in the southern port city of Karachi.
"The arrest order was served on him (Zadari) on Wednesday night," a police official said but gave no details.
The official said police had also detained Abdullah Shah, former chief minister of Sindh province during Bhutto's government for alleged involvement in a land scam.
Shah was picked up from his residence for interrogation and later placed in detention, the official said.
Earlier on Wednesday, the Sindh High Court had ordered the release of Zardari, who had been investment minister in his wife's cabinet, after it ruled his detention void.
